title: Lost or stolen card
keywords: lost stolen missing freeze block card theft
answer: Lock the card in your bank’s official app if that option is available. Contact the bank using its verified website or official support number to report the loss and ask about a replacement. Review recent activity and report unfamiliar charges.

title: Unrecognized card transaction
keywords: fraud unauthorized unfamiliar unrecognized dispute charge transaction purchase
answer: Review the merchant name and transaction date in your official banking app. If you still don’t recognize the charge, contact the bank through a verified channel to report it and ask about the dispute process.

title: Transfer status
keywords: transfer pending failed delayed payment recipient sent money reversal
answer: Check the status and reference in your official banking app. If the transfer is pending, confirm its status before submitting another transfer. If you need an investigation, contact the bank through its official support channel.

title: Online banking access
keywords: password reset locked login pin otp credentials forgot access
answer: Use the password recovery option on your bank’s official website or app. Never share your password, PIN, or one-time code in chat or with callers.

title: Account statements
keywords: statement statements download pdf history records
answer: Open the account in your official banking app or website and look for Statements. Select the period you need and use the available download option.

title: Suspicious messages and calls
keywords: scam phishing suspicious text sms link email call fake impersonation
answer: Avoid opening links or calling numbers in the message. Contact the bank through a verified channel. If you already shared credentials, contact the bank promptly and use the official recovery process.

title: Fees and limits
keywords: fee fees charge charges limit limits minimum overdraft rates
answer: Check your bank’s current fee schedule or product terms for your account type. Contact official support for an account-specific explanation.
